gates.name: Repository CI and packaging baseline
acceptance_criteria: Unit and integration tests pass
Static analysis and frontend build pass
Wheel contains backend entry point and critical modules
Docker image builds

evidence.note: Historical main-branch baseline; rerun against the actual release candidate.

gates.name: Dependency and secret scanning baseline
acceptance_criteria: Dependency vulnerability audit passes
Secret scanning passes

evidence.note: Historical main-branch baseline; rerun against the actual release candidate.

gates.name: Phase implementation forensic audits
acceptance_criteria: Phase 15 and Phase 16 forensic audits are present and distinguish implementation evidence from external readiness

gates.name: Representative, independently labeled AI-text effectiveness evaluation
acceptance_criteria: Versioned dataset manifest with SHA-256 hashes and documented collection/labeling methodology
Held-out evaluation data that is not used for detector tuning
Coverage for prompt injection, credential exfiltration, covert-channel behavior, AI-text C2-like behavior, data poisoning, and benign hard negatives
Results stratified by detector, model/provider, language, attack family, and benign/attack class
Precision, recall, false-positive rate, confidence intervals, sample sizes, and error analysis reported
Independent reviewer signs the evaluation report
gates.blocker: No qualifying independently labeled AI-text evaluation corpus and report is recorded in the repository evidence ledger. Network/ThreatFade tests are not a substitute for AI-text validation.

gates.name: Independent security assessment
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer is independent of implementation and has declared conflicts of interest
Review covers threat model, authorization boundaries, fail-closed behavior, multi-tenant isolation, evidence integrity, detector evaluation, dependency and deployment controls
Findings have severity, reproduction evidence, owners, and verified closure or an explicitly accepted risk
Reviewer signs a final report tied to the release candidate SHA
gates.blocker: No signed independent assessment tied to a release candidate SHA is recorded.

gates.name: Controlled production deployment and rollback drill
acceptance_criteria: Immutable image digest and environment identity recorded
Production configuration and TLS checks pass
Two-tenant isolation smoke tests pass
Readiness, alert routing, outbox delivery, rollback and post-deploy verification are evidenced
No claim of deployment is based solely on CI
gates.blocker: No production deployment attestation or rollback-drill evidence is recorded.

gates.name: Database restore and recovery verification
acceptance_criteria: Encrypted backup restored into an isolated environment
Migration state, tenant isolation, event/outbox integrity, and application startup verified
Measured RPO/RTO, recovery gaps, operator and timestamp recorded
Drill artifacts contain no raw prompts, completions, or secrets
gates.blocker: No successful restore drill is evidenced.

gates.name: Operational SLO measurement
acceptance_criteria: Metrics use a documented source, measurement window, exclusions and sample size
Availability, latency, dependency degradation, and outbox delivery are measured under representative traffic
Thresholds and alert response are reviewed before launch
gates.blocker: The SLOs in docs/OPERATIONS.md are proposed targets, not observed production measurements.

gates.name: Review of regulatory and certification claims
acceptance_criteria: Applicability and product claims are reviewed by an authorized legal/compliance owner
Evidence exports are not described as regulator submissions or legal determinations
Any certification claim has current external evidence and defined scope
gates.blocker: No legal/compliance approval tied to a release candidate is recorded.
